Primary semantic assertion (unmodified vendor evidence):
CVE-2019-25162 has fixed product
BaseOS-9.5.0.GA:kernel-core-0:5.14.0-503.11.1.el9_5.x86_64.
Its default_component_of relationship joins the exact kernel-core RPM to
BaseOS-9.5.0.GA, whose normative CPE is
cpe:/o:redhat:enterprise_linux:9::baseos.
The component purl is
pkg:rpm/redhat/kernel-core@5.14.0-503.11.1.el9_5?arch=x86_64.
The normalized record therefore targets native RHEL 9 standard x86_64, binary
kernel-core, fixed EVR 0:5.14.0-503.11.1.el9_5, without a module stream.

The fixture establishes actual large-document ingestion, not complete source
coverage, publication freshness, entitlement, or a full production republish.
